title: ActonOS Chat Channel Account
description: Canonical account item shared by every chat channel plugin (Discord, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Zalo). Plugin manifests embed these properties inside config_schema.properties.accounts.items and add platform-specific credentials.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this bot account

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

listen_target.title: Listen Target
listen_target.description: Optional conversation to restrict polling (Discord/Slack channel ID, Telegram chat ID). Leave empty to use the platform default.

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Broadcast a typing / chat-action event while the agent generates a reply

enable_ack_reaction.title: Acknowledge with Reaction
enable_ack_reaction.description: React to the user's inbound message (default 👀) to acknowledge receipt

enable_reply_quote.title: Quote / Thread Reply
enable_reply_quote.description: Attach outbound replies to the source message (quote, thread, or message reference)

ack_reaction_emoji.title: Acknowledgement Emoji
ack_reaction_emoji.description: Emoji used for inbound acknowledgement reactions
